verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes that hit bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials). No item shows the Nevada Secretary of State publishing processing times for any transaction type, so the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the site content was never reachable, not because it was checked and found lacking.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
